item.title: XOR'ing a register with itself is the idiom for zeroing it out. Why not sub?
item.description:
📝 You can imagine that the instruction, in some sense, “takes zero cycles to execute”. Fortunately, Itanium also has a dedicated zero register, so you don’t need this trick. You can just move zero into your desired destination.
🔗 Read more: https://devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20260421-00/?p=112247
